compute_teds_score: compute the tree-edit-distance score between a ground truth HTML table and a predicted HTML table
build_teds_scorer: build a TEDScorer instance to evaluate HTML table similarity using tree-edit-distance
convert_html_to_tree: convert an HTML table element into an APTED-compatible TableTree structure
tokenize_table_cell: tokenize the text content of an HTML table cell node for comparison
compare_table_nodes: compare two HTML table nodes for tag, colspan, rowspan, and cell content differences
